name: visual-density
description: Visual hierarchy and density for interfaces: type scales, spacing rhythm, visual weight, heading parity, scanning, and how dense each screen should be.

plugins.name: visual-density
plugins.description: Classifies each screen (landing, consumer, reading, productivity, operational), then sets or fixes the type scale, spacing, emphasis, heading parity and density for it — and measures the rendered page before and after with a bundled audit script.
